solutionContexts.label: AgNO3/PVP aqueous feed before NaCl
solutionContexts.scope: 170 mg AgNO3 and 170 mg PVP in 40 mL pure water. The later 400 µL NaCl stock is separate. Component cards do not assign dissolved speciation.

solutionContexts.label: 1 M TEOS in ethanol
solutionContexts.scope: Source gives 1 M TEOS ethanol solution and five separate 50/150/300/500/800 µL additions. Stock preparation and silica species geometry are unreported.

solutionContexts.label: 0.55 µM commercial QD dispersion
solutionContexts.scope: 100 µL of 0.55 µM purchased CdSe/ZnS QD dispersion was added. Source does not identify the supplied stock solvent. Figure 3 optical dispersions are in ethanol; unadsorbed QDs remain.

solutionContexts.label: 5.0 M aqueous NaCl
solutionContexts.scope: 400 µL of 5.0 M aqueous NaCl enters the initial AgNO3/PVP feed. Stock preparation and resulting AgCl concentration are not reported.

solutionContexts.label: 0.5 M aqueous NaOH
solutionContexts.scope: 40 mL of 0.5 M aqueous NaOH is present in the 360 mL mixed reductant wording. The source does not resolve whether 40 mL is included in 360 mL.

solutionContexts.label: 50% aqueous dimethylamine
solutionContexts.scope: The same source-described 50% aqueous DA reagent has separate 750 µL silica and 330 µL amination-stage aliquots. Percentage basis and resulting pH are unreported.

solutionContexts.label: 16 µM aminosilane in ethanol
solutionContexts.scope: 190 µL of 16 µM aminosilane ethanol solution enters each stated treatment. Surface coverage and solution geometry are not measured.

solutionContexts.label: Mixed aqueous reductant
solutionContexts.scope: AgCl dispersion is added into 360 mL of mixed aqueous solution containing 2800 mg L-ascorbic acid and 40 mL 0.5 M NaOH. The 360/40 mL relation is unresolved; no final molarity is inferred.
